jsonld_raw.name: (150 G) MUSK SHADE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle. Contains vegetable wax.

Musk Shades | The clarity of the musk reflects a fragrance full of innocence and sweetness. The explosion of citrus notes and tea leaves gives way to an impeccable floral aura of sun-drenched jasmine and mimosa petals. The musk remains in the background, offering a sense of unparalleled purity.

Aromatic notes:
Top notes: kumquat, mint.
Heart notes: mimosa, transparent floral.
Base notes: tea, musk.
